svg.desc: The Super agent, by DeepSeek definition, is centered to the left of LLAgentWorkers. Three illustrative task queues connect in both directions to the harnesses. Claude connects to Queue 1, Codex connects to Queue 2, and Pydantic and OpenCode share Queue 3. Claude, Codex, and Pydantic form a vertical stack on the right. OpenCode is centered below LLAgentWorkers and aligned with Pydantic. Its link enters through the bottom of LLAgentWorkers and connects to Queue 3. An LLAJinja box contains the Worker in OpenCode and an Agent and Worker in Claude. An LLAssemblyCLI box contains both Agents in Codex. Pydantic lists Memory and Monty sandbox above its two sub-agents.
